name: Signature Condition
definition: Specifies the signature requirements for managing an account.

RequiredSignatureNumber.name: Required Signature Number
RequiredSignatureNumber.definition: Number of account owners or related parties required to authorise transactions on the account.

SignatoryRightIndicator.name: Signatory Right Indicator
SignatoryRightIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the signature of the account owner is required to authorise transactions on the account.

SignatureOrderIndicator.name: Signature Order Indicator
SignatureOrderIndicator.definition: Indicator whether a certain order of signatures has to be respected or not.

SignatureOrder.name: Signature Order
SignatureOrder.definition: Indicates the order in which the mandate holders are allowed to sign.

Mandate.name: Mandate
Mandate.definition: Mandate for which signature conditions are provided.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.definition: Manual or digital signature added as security provision by each party involved in the business covered by the document.
